correctness.rationale: Over C for general P7 of 8x8 alternating forms, rank≤4 degeneracy locus has expected codimension C(4,2)=6 and deeper rank≤2 codim15, hence a smooth connected curve D. The rank-four kernel K gives normal bundle wedge²K*⊗O_D(1), det K*=O_D(2), det normal=O_D(12), so adjunction ω_D=O_D(4); degree84 is the Harris–Tu input, hence 2g−2=336, g=169 and χ(O_D(m))=84m−168. Block skew Schur complement reduces the Pfaffian transverse to D to a nondegenerate six-variable quadratic z1z6−z2z5+z3z4, giving scheme-theoretic reduced singular D. Blow-up along D resolves each transverse ordinary cone, exceptional Plücker Gr_D(2,K*) Klein-quadric 4-fold with globally separate two families P_D(K), P_D(K*), and discrepancy (6−1)−2=3. Independently checked quadratic Hessian rank6 determinant −1, degree84, genus169 and discrepancy3. Generality and algebraic characteristic zero are essential; an arbitrary special P7 is not covered.
